in_sanskrit.name: क्षिरज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the king of all that is sweet and nourishing, like milk.

in_hindi.name: क्षिरज
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the king of milk.

in_tamil.name: க்ஷிரர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the king of milk.

in_telugu.name: క్౷ీరేశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the lord or king of milk.

in_marathi.name: Kshiraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Milk
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshiraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kshiraj is the king of milk ocean, who later became the God of rain and agriculture. He is also known as Indra, the God of thunder and rain.

in_bengali.name: Kshiraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ King of Milk
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kshiraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Kshiraj is the king of milk ocean, who later became the God of rain and agriculture. He is also known as Indra, the God of thunder and rain.
